twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: HotSpawn crowd: 96% Aurora / 4% 9z (crowd context only). luchov posted 1.61 rating.
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: Headline Day 1 upset. Aurora allowed Nuke and lost 1–13 after dropping Inferno 11–13. Proves a Tier-2/low-owned underdog can sweep a top-6 team when the map veto exposes a weak map, but does not prove an unconditional anti-Aurora rule.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: Falcons (#4 Valve VRS, 1859 pts) survived Ancient OT then dominated Dust2.
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: Veteran IGL karrigan + NiKo + m0NESY closed out Group A opener cleanly in 2 maps.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: Legacy (#21 VRS, 1465 pts) edged PARIVISION in two tight maps (24 and 30 rounds).
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: Legacy showed strong Dust2/Mirage closing resilience to reach Group B Winners match.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: FURIA (#6 VRS, 1795 pts; #4 HLTV) controlled both maps behind KSCERATO & molodoy.
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: FURIA established Mirage & Ancient control early; BetBoom dropped to elimination bracket.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: Aurora pivoted away from Nuke and picked Cache for the first time at TWC 2026.
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: Counter-evidence to a blind "Aurora is broken" fade: switching their map pick to Cache stabilized Aurora’s T-side calling and eliminated NIP 2–0.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: 9z took Mirage 13–8 off #4 VRS Falcons, but Falcons closed Nuke & Dust2 13–9.
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: Falcons locked the Group A #1 seed and earned a full Day 3 off (~48h rest before Semifinal 2). 9z proved their Day 1 form was competitive on Mirage, setting up the Day 3 rematch with Aurora.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: BetBoom (#26 VRS, 1409 pts) reverse-swept PARIVISION with dominant Anubis & Mirage.
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: BetBoom’s 13–4 Anubis and 13–7 Mirage bounce-back established genuine map-pool upside heading into the Day 3 Group B decider vs Legacy.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: Legacy took Cache 13–10, then FURIA dominated Inferno (13–5) and Mirage (13–8).
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: FURIA locked Group B #1 seed and earned all of Day 3 off (~41h rest before Semifinal 1 vs Aurora), while exposing Cache (10–13 loss) as a map to watch against Aurora.

twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: Pre-lock bookmaker consensus: Aurora 66.61% / 9z 33.39% (Pinnacle 1.448/2.84, Bovada -215/+160, Melbet 1.404/2.792). HotSpawn crowd: 89% Aurora / 11% 9z. Canonical pick: Aurora (9z rejected as contrarian swing: 33.39% < 35.00% floor).
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: Vindicated the strict 35% "not stupid" floor! Instead of blindly repeating the Day 1 9z upset, the 35% floor kept Aurora as the pick. Coach ash & IGL kyxsan (1.45 rating, 33–20 K-D) ditched Nuke for Cache (13–11, winning round 24 on a low-buy) and crushed 9z 13–4 on Inferno behind Wicadia’s CT B-site AWP hold.

twc_matches_d1_d3.score: LIVE 1–1 on Map 3 Mirage (series winner — unverified at capture)
twc_matches_d1_d3.maps: Nuke 16–13 OT (BetBoom), Dust2 13–11 (Legacy), Mirage (decider in progress)
twc_matches_d1_d3.prematch_context: Pre-lock bookmaker consensus: Legacy 60.77% / BetBoom 39.23% (Bovada -165/+130, Melbet 1.53/2.39; Pinnacle -183/+141). HotSpawn crowd: 83% Legacy / 17% BetBoom (2.31× leverage). Canonical Safe Pick: Legacy (60.77%); Qualified Contrarian Swing: BetBoom (39.23% >= 35% floor).
twc_matches_d1_d3.strategic_takeaway: Validated BetBoom as a live 39.23% underdog: BetBoom won Map 1 Nuke 16–13 OT and pushed Map 2 Dust2 to 11–13 to force Map 3 Mirage. Critically for Day 4 Semifinal 2: whichever team survives this grueling 3-map late series faces a rested Falcons squad (<22h turnaround vs Falcons’ ~48h rest) after revealing its full 3-map playbook.

twc_day4_semifinals.hotspawn_status: Unposted on HotSpawn lobby at 19:44Z capture (awaiting Day 3 completion)
twc_day4_semifinals.canonical_status: Priced tie (50.00% / 50.00% on Melbet 1.87/1.87) — no forced directional bias until a second bookmaker breaks the tie
twc_day4_semifinals.recommended_safe_pick: FURIA (50.00% Melbet; 52.76% early Kalshi mid; #4 HLTV; full Day 3 rest advantage) — or follow the closing >=2-book favorite
twc_day4_semifinals.recommended_contrarian_pick: PRIMARY DAY 4 CONTRARIAN LEVERAGE SPOT: Both FURIA (50.00%) and Aurora (50.00%) easily clear the >=35.0% "not stupid" floor. Once HotSpawn opens SF1 picks, pick whichever side of FURIA vs Aurora has lower crowd ownership (target <=35% crowd share for 1.43x–2.50x leverage with 0.00 expected-points sacrifice).
day1_to_day3_synthesis: Rest & Anti-Strat Edge (FURIA): FURIA went 2–0 in Group B (2–0 vs BetBoom, 2–1 vs Legacy) and had all of Day 3 (16 Oct) off (~41h rest), watching Aurora’s full Cache/Inferno demos vs 9z.

Veto & Map Pool Clash: Aurora permabans Ancient (85%); FURIA permabans Anubis (65%). FURIA holds a 3-month edge on Inferno (71% vs 56%; beat Legacy 13–5 on Day 2) and is 2–0 on Mirage at TWC (13–9 vs BB, 13–8 vs Legacy). Aurora fixed its Day 1 Nuke collapse (1–13 vs 9z) by picking Cache on Days 2–3 (13–9 vs NIP, 13–11 vs 9z; 56% 3m vs FURIA’s 42% after FURIA lost Cache 10–13 to Legacy).
Star Form & H2H: KSCERATO leads TWC at 1.46 rating (molodoy 1.22) vs Aurora’s Wicadia (1.22) and kyxsan (1.45 in Day 3 decider). Aurora won the recent EPL S24 H2H 2–1 on 7 Oct 2026 (#2398743).

twc_day4_semifinals.recommended_safe_pick: Falcons (75.64%–78.49% calibrated VRS; 90.08%–92.55% raw VRS) — Chalk Anchor
twc_day4_semifinals.recommended_contrarian_pick: DO NOT FADE FALCONS (Hold Contrarian Bullet for SF1): Both Legacy (24.36% cal. VRS) and BetBoom (21.51% cal. VRS) project >10 percentage points below our 35.00% "not stupid" floor, AND suffer a severe rest/information disadvantage (<22h after back-to-back 3-map wars vs Falcons’ ~48h rest). Only reconsider if >=2 licensed bookmakers open the Group B winner at >=35.0% no-vig probability (<=2.65 decimal) with <=20% crowd ownership.
day1_to_day3_synthesis: Rest & Prep Asymmetry (Falcons): Falcons finished Group A 2–0 on 15 Oct ~14:30 UTC (2–0 vs NIP, 2–1 vs 9z), giving karrigan, NiKo & m0NESY ~50 hours of rest and full demo visibility into BetBoom vs Legacy’s 3-map decider (Nuke 16–13, Dust2 11–13, Mirage).

Cumulative Fatigue on Group B Survivor: Both Legacy (1–2 vs FURIA Day 2, 3 maps on Day 3) and BetBoom (2–1 vs PARIVISION Day 2, 3 maps on Day 3) played back-to-back 3-map elimination/decider series across Days 2–3.
Rating Gap: Falcons (#4 VRS, 1859 pts) hold a +394 pt VRS edge over Legacy (#21, 1465 pts) and a +450 pt VRS edge over BetBoom (#26, 1409 pts).
